project_reports_context_ck.name: project_reports_context_ck
project_reports_context_ck.value: ("project_reports"."context" = 'project' AND "project_reports"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "project_reports"."day" IS NOT NULL) OR ("project_reports"."context" = 'general' AND "project_reports"."project_id" IS NULL AND "project_reports"."task_id" IS NULL AND "project_reports"."message" IS NOT NULL)

project_tasks_active_ck.name: project_tasks_active_ck
project_tasks_active_ck.value: "project_tasks"."active_until" IS NULL OR "project_tasks"."active_from" IS NULL OR "project_tasks"."active_until" >= "project_tasks"."active_from"

conversations_shop_ck.name: conversations_shop_ck
conversations_shop_ck.value: ("conversations"."kind" = 'direct' AND "conversations"."shop_id" IS NULL) OR ("conversations"."kind" = 'shop' AND "conversations"."shop_id" IS NOT NULL)

messages_content_ck.name: messages_content_ck
messages_content_ck.value: ("messages"."kind" = 'text' AND "messages"."text" IS NOT NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'photo' AND "messages"."media_key" IS NOT NULL) OR ("messages"."kind" = 'order' AND "messages"."order_id" IS NOT NULL) OR "messages"."status" <> 'published'

delivery_tariffs_values_ck.name: delivery_tariffs_values_ck
delivery_tariffs_values_ck.value: "delivery_tariffs"."base_fcfa" >= 0 AND "delivery_tariffs"."per_minute_fcfa" >= 0 AND "delivery_tariffs"."minimum_fcfa" >= 0 AND "delivery_tariffs"."rounding_fcfa" >= 1 AND "delivery_tariffs"."free_wait_minutes" >= 0 AND "delivery_tariffs"."wait_per_minute_fcfa" >= 0 AND "delivery_tariffs"."wait_cap_minutes" >= 0

orders_delivery_ck.name: orders_delivery_ck
orders_delivery_ck.value: "orders"."delivery_mode" IS DISTINCT FROM 'express' AND "orders"."delivery_mode" IS DISTINCT FROM 'economy' OR ("orders"."delivery_commune_code" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."delivery_address" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."delivery_fee_fcfa" IS NOT NULL AND "orders"."tariff_id" IS NOT NULL)

order_payments_review_idx.name: order_payments_review_idx
order_payments_review_idx.where: "order_payments"."review_queued_at" IS NOT NULL AND "order_payments"."reviewed_at" IS NULL

order_payments_provider_ck.name: order_payments_provider_ck
order_payments_provider_ck.value: ("order_payments"."provider_status" = 'unavailable' AND "order_payments"."provider_confirmed_at" IS NULL) OR ("order_payments"."provider_status" = 'confirmed' AND "order_payments"."provider_confirmed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "order_payments"."method" = 'mobile_money')

reviews_item_ck.name: reviews_item_ck
reviews_item_ck.value: ("reviews"."kind" = 'item') = ("reviews"."order_item_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."product_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."product_reference" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."content_version" IS NOT NULL)

deliveries_return_ck.name: deliveries_return_ck
deliveries_return_ck.value: "deliveries"."returned_at" IS NULL OR ("deliveries"."status" IN ('refused_by_client', 'client_absent') AND "deliveries"."return_confirmed_by" IS NOT NULL)
